pattern.short_summary: An artifact the user already possesses or has produced — a draft, a collection, a document, a physical or staged arrangement, their own prior judgments — is ingested and used as the input the generation is conditioned on.
pattern.definition: An artifact the user already possesses or has produced — a draft, a collection, a document, a physical or staged arrangement, their own prior judgments — is ingested and used as the input the generation is conditioned on. The user supplies material rather than a description of what they want. The output is a function of that material.
pattern.structural_signature: The system exposes an ingestion path for a user-owned artifact (upload, parse, encode, capture) and routes it into the generator as conditioning state, either directly or after an encoding step. The generation cannot run without that artifact; changing it changes the output. The material is pre-existing with respect to the interaction — it is not authored in order to specify the request.

dimension.category_description: How users, artifacts, examples, parameters, or user-state signals specify intent and shape the system's next behavior.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a user-facing specification or adaptive interaction; invisible sensing infrastructure is excluded.
